+# Evidence only: never connected to Azure DevOps, never run.
+# build/test -> dev -> test -> prod, all three deployments from one stage template.
+# Prod waits for the approval configured on the 'policies-prod' Azure DevOps environment.
+trigger:
+  branches:
+    include: [main]
+
+pr: none
+
+variables:
+  - name: buildConfiguration
+    value: Release
+  - name: dotnetSdkVersion
+    value: 10.0.x
+
+stages:
+  - stage: Build
+    displayName: Build and test
+    jobs:
+      - job: BuildTest
+        pool:
+          vmImage: ubuntu-latest
+        steps:
+          - task: UseDotNet@2
+            displayName: Install .NET SDK
+            inputs:
+              packageType: sdk
+              version: $(dotnetSdkVersion)
+
+          - script: dotnet build Uinsure.Policies.slnx --configuration $(buildConfiguration) -warnaserror
+            displayName: Build
+
+          - script: dotnet test --solution Uinsure.Policies.slnx --configuration $(buildConfiguration)
+            displayName: Test
+
+          - script: |
+              mkdir -p $(Build.ArtifactStagingDirectory)/drop
+              dotnet tool install --global dotnet-ef
+              export PATH="$PATH:$HOME/.dotnet/tools"
+              dotnet ef migrations script --idempotent \
+                --project src/Uinsure.Policies.Persistence \
+                --startup-project src/Uinsure.Policies.Api \
+                --output $(Build.ArtifactStagingDirectory)/drop/migrations.sql
+            displayName: Generate idempotent migration script
+
+          - script: |
+              dotnet publish src/Uinsure.Policies.Api --configuration $(buildConfiguration) \
+                --output $(Build.ArtifactStagingDirectory)/publish
+              mkdir -p $(Build.ArtifactStagingDirectory)/drop
+              cd $(Build.ArtifactStagingDirectory)/publish
+              zip -r $(Build.ArtifactStagingDirectory)/drop/app.zip .
+              cp -r $(Build.SourcesDirectory)/infrastructure $(Build.ArtifactStagingDirectory)/drop/infrastructure
+            displayName: Package app and infrastructure
+
+          - publish: $(Build.ArtifactStagingDirectory)/drop
+            artifact: drop
+            displayName: Publish drop artifact
+
+  - template: stage-template.yml
+    parameters:
+      environmentName: dev
+      azureServiceConnection: sc-policies-dev
+      dependsOn: Build
+
+  - template: stage-template.yml
+    parameters:
+      environmentName: test
+      azureServiceConnection: sc-policies-test
+      dependsOn: Deploy_dev
+
+  - template: stage-template.yml
+    parameters:
+      environmentName: prod
+      azureServiceConnection: sc-policies-prod
+      dependsOn: Deploy_test

+++ b/infrastructure/pipelines/check-pipeline.py
@@ -0,0 +1,87 @@
+"""Offline check of the Azure DevOps pipeline YAML. Never contacts Azure or Azure DevOps.
+
+Run from the repo root:  python -I infrastructure/pipelines/check-pipeline.py
+Needs PyYAML and jsonschema. Exit 0 = pass, 1 = a check failed.
+
+1. Both files parse as YAML and match pipeline.schema.json.
+2. Rules the schema cannot express: one stage template used for dev, test and prod in order, what-if before
+   create, AzureCLI@2 inputs, prod approval environment, idempotent migrations, /health/ready smoke test,
+   App Insights setting supplied by Bicep, and no secret-looking literals.
+"""
+import json
+import re
+import sys
+from pathlib import Path
+
+import yaml
+from jsonschema import Draft202012Validator
+
+HERE = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
+errors = []
+
+
+def check(condition, message):
+    if not condition:
+        errors.append(message)
+
+
+def load(name):
+    return yaml.safe_load((HERE / name).read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
+
+
+schema = json.loads((HERE / "pipeline.schema.json").read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
+validator = Draft202012Validator(schema)
+pipeline = load("azure-pipelines.yml")
+template = load("stage-template.yml")
+
+for name, doc in (("azure-pipelines.yml", pipeline), ("stage-template.yml", template)):
+    for e in validator.iter_errors(doc):
+        errors.append(f"{name}: schema: {'/'.join(map(str, e.absolute_path))}: {e.message}")
+
+# One stage template, dev -> test -> prod.
+uses = [s for s in pipeline["stages"] if "template" in s]
+check([u["parameters"]["environmentName"] for u in uses] == ["dev", "test", "prod"], "template must be used for dev, test, prod in order")
+check(all(u["template"] == "stage-template.yml" for u in uses), "every deploy stage must use stage-template.yml")
+check([u["parameters"]["dependsOn"] for u in uses] == ["Build", "Deploy_dev", "Deploy_test"], "stages must chain Build -> dev -> test -> prod")
+check(any(s.get("stage") == "Build" for s in pipeline["stages"]), "missing Build stage")
+
+# Build stage: build, test, idempotent script.
+build_text = json.dumps(pipeline["stages"][0])
+for needle in ("dotnet build", "dotnet test", "migrations script --idempotent"):
+    check(needle in build_text, f"Build stage must run: {needle}")
+
+# Deploy steps.
+deploy = template["stages"][0]["jobs"][0]
+steps = deploy["strategy"]["runOnce"]["deploy"]["steps"]
+az = [s for s in steps if s.get("task") == "AzureCLI@2"]
+check(len(az) >= 3, "deploy needs AzureCLI@2 steps")
+for s in az:
+    inputs = s["inputs"]
+    for key in ("azureSubscription", "scriptType", "scriptLocation", "inlineScript"):
+        check(key in inputs, f"AzureCLI@2 '{s.get('displayName')}' missing input {key}")
+whatif = next((i for i, s in enumerate(steps) if "what-if" in s.get("inputs", {}).get("inlineScript", "")), None)
+create = next((i for i, s in enumerate(steps) if "deployment sub create" in s.get("inputs", {}).get("inlineScript", "")), None)
+check(whatif is not None and create is not None and whatif < create, "what-if must come before deployment sub create")
+text = (HERE / "stage-template.yml").read_text(encoding="utf-8")
+check("environment: policies-${{ parameters.environmentName }}" in text, "deployment must target environment policies-<env> (prod approval lives there)")
+check("/health/ready" in steps[-1].get("script", ""), "last step must curl /health/ready")
+check("curl" in steps[-1].get("script", "") and "--fail" in steps[-1].get("script", ""), "smoke test must be curl --fail")
+check("migrations.sql" in text, "migrations.sql must be applied")
+check("ActiveDirectoryAzCli" in text, "SQL access must use Entra authentication")
+
+# Secrets and the App Insights setting.
+combined = text + (HERE / "azure-pipelines.yml").read_text(encoding="utf-8")
+check(not re.search(r"(?i)password\s*[=:]|pwd=|accountkey|sharedaccesskey|instrumentationkey=", combined), "secret-looking literal found")
+bicep = (HERE.parent / "modules" / "appservice.bicep").read_text(encoding="utf-8")
+check("APPLICATIONINSIGHTS_CONNECTION_STRING" in bicep, "Bicep must set APPLICATIONINSIGHTS_CONNECTION_STRING")
+check("Active Directory Managed Identity" in bicep, "Bicep must use a managed identity connection string")
+check("SystemAssigned" in bicep, "App Service must have a system-assigned identity")
+sql = (HERE.parent / "modules" / "sql.bicep").read_text(encoding="utf-8")
+check("azureADOnlyAuthentication: true" in sql and "administratorLoginPassword" not in sql, "SQL must be Entra-only with no password")
+
+if errors:
+    print("pipeline check FAILED")
+    for e in errors:
+        print(" -", e)
+    sys.exit(1)
+print("pipeline check passed")

@@ -0,0 +1,109 @@
+parameters:
+  - name: environmentName
+    type: string
+  - name: azureServiceConnection
+    type: string
+  - name: dependsOn
+    type: string
+  - name: location
+    type: string
+    default: uksouth
+
+stages:
+  - stage: Deploy_${{ parameters.environmentName }}
+    displayName: Deploy ${{ parameters.environmentName }}
+    dependsOn: ${{ parameters.dependsOn }}
+    jobs:
+      - deployment: Deploy
+        displayName: Deploy to ${{ parameters.environmentName }}
+        pool:
+          vmImage: ubuntu-latest
+        # The environment carries the approval check; only policies-prod has one.
+        environment: policies-${{ parameters.environmentName }}
+        variables:
+          # Per-environment values (sqlAdminGroupObjectId, tenantId) live in a variable group, not in the repo.
+          - group: policies-${{ parameters.environmentName }}
+          - name: drop
+            value: $(Pipeline.Workspace)/drop
+        strategy:
+          runOnce:
+            deploy:
+              steps:
+                - task: AzureCLI@2
+                  displayName: What-if
+                  inputs:
+                    azureSubscription: ${{ parameters.azureServiceConnection }}
+                    scriptType: bash
+                    scriptLocation: inlineScript
+                    inlineScript: |
+                      az deployment sub what-if \
+                        --name policies-${{ parameters.environmentName }}-$(Build.BuildId) \
+                        --location ${{ parameters.location }} \
+                        --template-file $(drop)/infrastructure/main.bicep \
+                        --parameters $(drop)/infrastructure/params/${{ parameters.environmentName }}.bicepparam \
+                        --parameters sqlAdminGroupObjectId=$(sqlAdminGroupObjectId) tenantId=$(tenantId)
+
+                - task: AzureCLI@2
+                  name: infra
+                  displayName: Deploy infrastructure
+                  inputs:
+                    azureSubscription: ${{ parameters.azureServiceConnection }}
+                    scriptType: bash
+                    scriptLocation: inlineScript
+                    inlineScript: |
+                      outputs=$(az deployment sub create \
+                        --name policies-${{ parameters.environmentName }}-$(Build.BuildId) \
+                        --location ${{ parameters.location }} \
+                        --template-file $(drop)/infrastructure/main.bicep \
+                        --parameters $(drop)/infrastructure/params/${{ parameters.environmentName }}.bicepparam \
+                        --parameters sqlAdminGroupObjectId=$(sqlAdminGroupObjectId) tenantId=$(tenantId) \
+                        --query properties.outputs --output json)
+                      echo "##vso[task.setvariable variable=resourceGroupName]$(echo "$outputs" | jq -r .resourceGroupName.value)"
+                      echo "##vso[task.setvariable variable=appName]$(echo "$outputs" | jq -r .appName.value)"
+                      echo "##vso[task.setvariable variable=appHostName]$(echo "$outputs" | jq -r .appHostName.value)"
+                      echo "##vso[task.setvariable variable=sqlServerFqdn]$(echo "$outputs" | jq -r .sqlServerFqdn.value)"
+                      echo "##vso[task.setvariable variable=sqlDatabaseName]$(echo "$outputs" | jq -r .sqlDatabaseName.value)"
+
+                # Idempotent: the script from `dotnet ef migrations script --idempotent` skips applied migrations.
+                # The service principal signs in with its Entra token (it belongs to the SQL admin group); no SQL password exists.
+                # The agent needs go-sqlcmd (the `sqlcmd` on ubuntu-latest).
+                - task: AzureCLI@2
+                  displayName: Apply migrations
+                  inputs:
+                    azureSubscription: ${{ parameters.azureServiceConnection }}
+                    scriptType: bash
+                    scriptLocation: inlineScript
+                    inlineScript: |
+                      sqlcmd -S "$(sqlServerFqdn)" -d "$(sqlDatabaseName)" \
+                        --authentication-method ActiveDirectoryAzCli \
+                        -b -i $(drop)/migrations.sql
+
+                - task: AzureCLI@2
+                  displayName: Grant the app's managed identity database access
+                  inputs:
+                    azureSubscription: ${{ parameters.azureServiceConnection }}
+                    scriptType: bash
+                    scriptLocation: inlineScript
+                    inlineScript: |
+                      sqlcmd -S "$(sqlServerFqdn)" -d "$(sqlDatabaseName)" \
+                        --authentication-method ActiveDirectoryAzCli -b \
+                        -Q "IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM sys.database_principals WHERE name = '$(appName)') CREATE USER [$(appName)] FROM EXTERNAL PROVIDER; ALTER ROLE db_datareader ADD MEMBER [$(appName)]; ALTER ROLE db_datawriter ADD MEMBER [$(appName)];"
+
+                - task: AzureCLI@2
+                  displayName: Deploy app
+                  inputs:
+                    azureSubscription: ${{ parameters.azureServiceConnection }}
+                    scriptType: bash
+                    scriptLocation: inlineScript
+                    inlineScript: |
+                      az webapp deploy \
+                        --resource-group "$(resourceGroupName)" \
+                        --name "$(appName)" \
+                        --src-path $(drop)/app.zip \
+                        --type zip
+
+                - script: |
+                    curl --fail --silent --show-error \
+                      --retry 10 --retry-delay 15 --retry-all-errors \
+                      https://$(appHostName)/health/ready
+                  displayName: Smoke test /health/ready
